purpose: Teach: 製剤/仏像/床屋/駅伝/あご/観音/水銀/スマイル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新製剤のお仕事してらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been working on a new pharmaceutical compound.
lines.style: Conversational but slightly distant, as if sharing information from another part of the day. Warm but matter-of-fact. The cadence of a mother updating her son on the household.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんと仏像を拝んできたよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to pray at the temple with Grandma today.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick delivery, almost tumbling the words out. Small-boy pride in having done something grown-up. Looking up at her for recognition.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが近所の床屋さんへ行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's heading to the barber shop down the street.
lines.style: Same gentle, informational tone. Slightly more present than the first line, noticing him. The rhythm of a mother sharing small household updates.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、駅伝でお兄ちゃんたちの応援をしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I cheered for the older boys at the relay race.
lines.style: Immediate, excited. The words come faster. Real pride in having been part of something bigger. Seeking her approval, almost breathless with wanting her to understand how important it was.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんはあごひげをそりに行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather went to shave his beard.
lines.style: Same warm, observational tone. Slightly amused by the domestic detail. Not lecturing, just sharing what happened in the family's day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お母さんと観音様にお参りしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to pray at the Kannon temple with you.
lines.style: Soft correction, gentle. He's correcting her gently — it was with her, not someone else. Still eager, but with a small note of wanting her to remember correctly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い水銀の体温計を片付けてらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was cleaning out some old mercury thermometers.
lines.style: Practical, careful tone. A mother noting something that required handling. Not alarmed, but present with the detail. The weight of household management in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのスマイルが大好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really love Grandpa's smile.
lines.style: Soft, sincere, unprompted affection. The words come slower, more tender. No performance — just a genuine observation about someone he adores. A moment of real feeling.
